property_summary: For any fuzzed address, calling transferOwnership can never result in c.owner() == address(0) (the zero-address transfer reverts in the reference), but the mutant accepts address(0) and makes owner() become the zero address for the input newOwner == address(0).
change_summary: Remove the require that rejects the zero address so transferOwnership can set the owner to address(0), changing the observable owner value.
